name: bountynet-root
description: Top-level task runner for BountyNet subprojects.

scripts.bootstrap: npm --prefix clients/web install && npm --prefix projects/agent-market/console-ui install
scripts.dev: npm run dev:down && bash ./scripts/laptop-stack.sh up slice
scripts.dev:full: npm run dev:down && bash ./scripts/laptop-stack.sh up full
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:console
